Hangry is 100% local-first. We do not operate backend servers, cloud databases, user tracking, advertising SDKs, or remote analytics. Your health information never leaves your phone.

Hangry is a personal wellness insights application, not a medical device. It does not provide medical diagnoses, treatment advice, or clinically validated scores. Consult a medical professional for health concerns.
